# Reliability Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified Commerce Backend

**Purpose**: Assess whether inventory consistency, order-state transitions,
retries, compensation, and failure outcomes are complete and testable.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and
satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is
complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK020 - Are all order states, allowed transitions, terminal states, and transition causes explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-013–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK021 - Does every checkout failure mode identify the resulting order state, inventory state, payment state, customer-visible outcome, and recovery action? [Gap, Spec §User Stories 1–3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are timeout, connection failure, malformed downstream response, and unavailable dependency treated as distinct or intentionally equivalent failure conditions? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are all inventory reservation, confirmation, release, expiry, restock, and cancellation transitions defined for both single-item and multi-item orders? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are idempotency requirements defined for every mutating operation whose retry could duplicate stock, order, payment, refund, or compensation effects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, FR-014, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are recovery requirements defined for an interrupted saga whose last downstream call may have succeeded but whose response was lost? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK026 - Is “stock stays consistent” expressed as explicit invariants for available, reserved, confirmed, released, expired, and restored quantities? [Clarity, User Input]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the exact all-or-nothing rule stated for every multi-product reservation and checkout failure path? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the 15-minute reservation duration defined relative to a named event and clock, including behavior at the exact expiry boundary? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is “fairly” in concurrent stock allocation replaced by an objective ordering or explicitly excluded as a guarantee? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are “recoverable state,” “compensation pending,” and “retry” defined with allowed transitions and operator/customer actions? [Ambiguity, Plan §Order saga]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK031 - Do payment failure requirements consistently distinguish a persisted failed/cancelled order from a confirmed order and from an order awaiting compensation? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, FR-010–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK032 - Do cancellation requirements consistently permit cancellation before delivery while defining what happens when payment, refund, or restock is pending? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, FR-013–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK033 - Do reservation expiry and explicit release requirements both guarantee exactly-once stock restoration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK034 - Do the optimistic-locking and saga requirements preserve the same no-oversell invariant under concurrent retries and compensation? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK035 - Can every defined failure path be mapped to one and only one observable order state? [Measurability, User Input]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are the exact expected counts for orders, charges, refunds, reservations, and restored stock specified for retries and partial failures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004–SC-007]
- [ ] CHK037 - Can the concurrent last-unit requirement be evaluated without relying on “nearly the same time” or another undefined timing phrase? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are recovery deadlines, retry limits, or explicit operator actions defined for failures that remain pending? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK039 - Are duplicate, delayed, reordered, and lost responses covered for reservation, payment, refund, release, and restock calls? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are price/discount changes, cart changes, inventory changes, and customer acknowledgement rules defined for checkout retries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK041 - Are failure outcomes defined when compensation itself fails repeatedly or only partially completes? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, FR-014]

## Notes

- All newly generated items intentionally remain unchecked for reviewer-owned assessment.
- User-specified reliability focus incorporated: inventory consistency and a
  defined order state for every failure.
- Vague terms explicitly flagged include “fairly,” “recoverable,” and “clear.”
